course_name: 雷射醫學的基礎與臨床應用
outline: The laser is one of the three major items invented in 20th century.  Medical laser applications have been widely used in many fields.  This course will cover: 1. Laser Physics; 2. Safety Standards; 3. Laser-Tissue-Interaction; 4. Laser in Medical Applications; 5. Laser in Periodontology; 6. Laser in Oral Surgery; 7. Laser Assisted Bleaching; 8. Low Level Laser Therapy; 9. Practical Hands-on and Live Demonstration.
